name: Lerthai Finance Limited
about: Lerthai Finance Limited provides financing and investment services primarily in India. The company focuses on real estate, fintech, and capital market sectors. The company was formerly known as Marathwada Refractories Limited and changed its name to Lerthai Finance Limited in December 2018. Lerthai Finance Limited was incorporated in 1979 and is based in Bengaluru, India. Lerthai Finance Limited operates as a subsidiary of Calvera Capital Pte Ltd.
